project_title: Italienation: Citizen-First Open Science Observatory on the Italian Educational Pipeline & NEET Exclusion
osf_repository_intent: Empirical validation of the Extended Social Mobility Triangle with School Track (O-T-E-D) across Italian NUTS-2 regions and European benchmarks.

canonical_datasets.name_it: Ripetenti per anno di corso e indirizzo scolastico nella Scuola Secondaria di II Grado
canonical_datasets.name_en: Upper Secondary Grade Repeaters by Year of Course and School Track
canonical_datasets.data_portal: ISTAT SDMX Open Data Portal (I.Stat / Esploradati)
canonical_datasets.role_in_oed_triangle: Measures Track-to-Education friction (T -> E). Proves the 18.0% first-year failure concentration in Istituti Professionali.

canonical_datasets.name_it: Tasso di Giovani NEET (15–29 anni) e Povertà Educativa Regionale / Provinciale
canonical_datasets.name_en: Youth NEET Rate (15–29 years) and Territorial Educational Poverty
canonical_datasets.institution: Openpolis & ISTAT (Osservatorio Povertà Educativa Con i Bambini)
canonical_datasets.data_portal: Openpolis Dati Aperti / ISTAT Rilevazione sulle Forze di Lavoro (RFL)
canonical_datasets.role_in_oed_triangle: Measures the ultimate social and labor market destination (D) resulting from early school leaving (ELET).

canonical_datasets.name_it: Strutture dei Sistemi Educativi Europei (ISCED 0–4) e Indicatori Politici ELET
canonical_datasets.name_en: European Education System Structures (ISCED 0–4) and ELET System-Level Policy Indicators
canonical_datasets.institution: EURYDICE Network (European Education and Culture Executive Agency - EACEA / European Commission)
canonical_datasets.data_portal: Eurydice Data and Visuals / Eurydice Open Data
canonical_datasets.role_in_oed_triangle: Provides the structural system parameters (Tracking Age T, Bocciatura legal rules) to conduct comparative causal analysis between Italy and European benchmarks.

canonical_datasets.name_it: Contribuzione Media Studentesca e Tasso di Abbandono Universitario al Primo Anno
canonical_datasets.name_en: Average University Tuition Fees and First-Year University Dropout Rate
canonical_datasets.institution: MUR (Ministero dell'Università e della Ricerca - Ufficio Statistica)
canonical_datasets.data_portal: Portale Dati dell'Istruzione Superiore (Dati Aperti MUR)
canonical_datasets.role_in_oed_triangle: Measures downstream tertiary progression shock (E -> D), showing how high school repetition predetermines first-year university dropout.

canonical_datasets.name_it: Benchmark Internazionale OCSE/World Bank: Età di Tripartizione vs. Tasso Lordo di Iscrizione Terziaria
canonical_datasets.name_en: OECD/World Bank International Benchmark: Tracking Age vs. Gross Tertiary Enrollment Rate
canonical_datasets.institution: OECD (Education at a Glance) & World Bank (EdStats Database)
canonical_datasets.data_portal: OECD Data Explorer / World Bank Open Data
canonical_datasets.role_in_oed_triangle: Proves empirically that unified comprehensive secondary systems (>16 years tracking age) achieve +14.4% higher university enrollment than early tripartite models.

canonical_datasets.name_it: Spesa Comunale SIOPE per Alunno e Anagrafe Edilizia Scolastica (Agibilità e Barriere Architettoniche)
canonical_datasets.name_en: SIOPE Municipal Cash Expenditure per Pupil and School Building Safety Registry
canonical_datasets.institution: MIM (Ministero dell'Istruzione e del Merito) & MEF (Banca d'Italia SIOPE)
canonical_datasets.data_portal: Portale Unico Dati della Scuola (MIM Open Data) & SIOPE Open Data
canonical_datasets.role_in_oed_triangle: Measures the baseline institutional and territorial resources (O -> School Environment) before secondary tracking begins.
